payload.text:
NEWSROOM BRIEF

Meta's Q3 results show investment outrunning cash generation

Meta generated more operating cash in Q3.

What to watch: The next test is whether operating cash generation can again cover equipment purchases and finance-lease principal through comparable periods.

Full brief: https://capitalchronicle.substack.com/p/pending-publication-253e284c9ada8aae
